notes: §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR11: "If the storage medium for the file permits rewinding, the following rules apply": a, with none of REVERSED, EXTEND and NO REWIND, "execution of the OPEN statement causes the file to be positioned at its beginning"; b, "When the NO REWIND phrase is specified, execution of the OPEN statement does not cause the file to be repositioned; the file must be already positioned at its beginning prior to execution of the OPEN statement."; c, "When the REVERSED phrase is specified, the file is positioned at its end by execution of the OPEN statement." Rule a: SequentialConnector.OpenCore resets the read offset and the record ordinal at every OPEN, with no edition arm, so INPUT and I-O read from the first record and OUTPUT starts an empty file. Rule c: BindOpen binds REVERSED into the one tape-phrase slot, VisitOpenFileSpec admits the phrase at 85 only (COBOL0902 from 2002), and FileRegistry.OpenArbitrated runs ReversedPhraseEffect after a successful open; it calls PositionReversed, which sets the file position indicator one past the last record, from a count taken inside the OPEN body. Rule b is the arm of a medium that can be left where it stands, and the implementation has none: every sequential file is a host file of the non-reel/unit category (SequentialConnector.Category; docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7, row DOC-A.1-24), so NO REWIND is a phrase §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR10 says "will be ignored": the OPEN positions the file at its beginning as under rule a, and NoRewindPhraseEffect sets I-O status 07 (§1985:VII.1.3.5: "for an OPEN statement with the NO REWIND phrase, the referenced file is on a non-reel/unit medium"). REVERSED is honoured on the same host file because the runtime can deliver its records in reversed order, the capability the phrase depends on (§1985:C.3, item 14: "a reel or mass storage type of device having the capability of making records available in the reversed order"). Probed at --std 85: after two READs and a CLOSE, OPEN INPUT and OPEN I-O each deliver the first record; after CLOSE WITH NO REWIND in mid-file, OPEN INPUT WITH NO REWIND answers 07 and delivers the first record; OPEN INPUT REVERSED delivers the last record first on fixed and variable-length files; an empty file and an absent OPTIONAL file (status 05) give the at end condition on the first READ; an unsuccessful REVERSED open (35) positions nothing. The witness reads one record, closes WITH NO REWIND, reopens and reads the first record again, then opens WITH NO REWIND and reads the first record.

next.reason: 1985: "When neither the REVERSED, the EXTEND, nor the NO REWIND phrase is specified ... c. When the REVERSED phrase is specified, the file is positioned at its end"; 2023: "When neither the EXTEND, nor the NO REWIND phrase is specified, execution of the OPEN statement causes the file to be positioned at its beginning.". Rules a and b carry over in substance. 2023 has no REVERSED phrase, so the case of positioning the file at its end on OPEN REVERSED (rule c) is gone.
